thread:
alex_g: Hey team — opened PR  #61327. It's a small opt-in telemetry sampling and runner-config toggle for the model-runner that should reduce tracing noise during heavy batch windows. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I schedule a canary.
sasha_p: link? can you drop the PR and a quick TL;DR of risk surface
alex_g: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/61327
PR TL;DR: changes default sampling rate for internal traces from 100% -> 10% for model-runner ops, adds config flag `runner.telemetry.sampling_rate` (0.0-1.0) and a guarded fastpath so when sampling < 1 we avoid allocating trace objects in the hot path. No changes to customer-visible metrics.
code snippet:
```yaml
runner:
  telemetry:
    sampling_rate: 0.1
```
jordan_runtime: :eyes: I'll take a look at the hot-path guard and inline allocations. If the fastpath is safe we should be fine. Any perf numbers?
alex_g: ran microbench on devbox: p50 token latency down ~1.2% when sampling=0.1, overhead eliminated on no-sample path. Will paste perf gist in a sec.
tim_o: @jordan_runtime @paul_infra can you confirm this doesn't change eviction/kv cache tracing hooks? we had one bug where traces forced KV loads.
jordan_runtime: I scanned the trace hooks — they still call the same Trace::start/finish but the fastpath short-circuits before alloc. I'll add an assert to ensure no additional allocations in the hot path. Planning a quick unit to validate.
paul_infra: From infra side, two asks: 1) add a rollout plan (canary % and region), 2) ensure config can be toggled via infra config manager without redeploy. Canary percentages? suggested 5->20->50 over 24h.
alex_g: Proposed canary: 5% (1h) -> 20% (6h) -> 50% (12h) with auto-rollback on error rate spike. I'll add it to the PR description.
lina_sec: Quick security check: does changing sampling affect PII capture or trace retention policy? We should confirm traces don't stringify user inputs differently.
alex_g: No PII changes. Sampling only gates whether we create trace objects; payloads are unchanged. I'll add a note and link to our trace-PII checklist.
sasha_p: Can we get a formal ack from runtime + infra + security before scheduling? @jordan_runtime @paul_infra @lina_sec
jordan_runtime: Ack from runtime after I land the tiny assert/unit. Will comment in the PR when done. :white_check_mark:
paul_infra: Ack from infra assuming config toggle path exists; file a follow-up ops ticket for the infra flag rollout. :white_check_mark:
lina_sec: Ack from security, added two minor doc comments (PII checklist link and retention TTL note). :white_check_mark:
alex_g: Thanks all — I'll add the canary schedule and ops ticket, then request merge window. pinging @deploy-bot when canary ready.
deploy-bot: noted — canary scheduled once PR is merged and infra flag is available. Will post status updates in #deploys.
sasha_p: sweet. assigning merge steward to alex_g for slot coordination. if anything blocks, drop an update here. :slightly_smiling_face:
